findings.title: Scope-match statement contradicts the recorded scope limitation
findings.page_quote: Intervention level: topic is class-level, comparator is class-level (match: True)

evidence.quote: pools the IL-6-antagonist CLASS (tocilizumab + sarilumab), a broader PICO than this tocilizumab-only topic.

findings.why: The page presents a class-level match although the review's scope note explicitly distinguishes this single-agent topic from the broader comparator.
findings.fix: Resolve the conflicting scope fields and render the recorded single-agent versus class-level limitation.

findings.title: COVACTA count-availability statement contradicts the admitted trial row
findings.page_quote: COVACTA gives mortality as a RATE only (19.7% vs 19.4%, no per-arm counts)
findings.why: The current COVACTA row contains mortality counts of 58/294 versus 28/144. The comparator narrative incorrectly describes those counts as unavailable.
findings.fix: Update the source narrative to reflect the admitted COVACTA counts and current pool.

findings.title: Conclusion incorrectly labels significance as exclusion of the null
findings.why: The recorded interval touches the null at 1.0. A significance flag cannot accurately be presented as saying that this displayed interval excludes the null.
findings.fix: Label the significance field accurately and render interval exclusion separately, preserving the recorded touches-null state.
